name: Helping Hand for Relief and Development
mission: Helping Hand for Relief and Development is a global humanitarian relief and development organization responding to human sufferings in emergency and disastrous situations anywhere all over the world regardless race, gender, ethnicity, class, location, religion, color, cultural diversity and social background; with special focus on countries where the massive population is living below the poverty line. In addition to our emergency relief efforts in natural or man made disaster areas, we also work on long term relief and development programs like livelihood, economic empowerment, orphan and widows support program and skill development program.
theoryOfChange: HHRD recognizes education as a basic human right and one of the most direct and viable pathways out of poverty. We believe that graduating from a four-year degree program after intermediate is the most effective means for our students to earn higher lifetime incomes, have better health outcomes, and enjoy fulfilling lives.

rich_narrative.summary:
Helping Hand for Relief and Development (HHRD) is a global humanitarian aid organization that provides emergency relief, orphan care, and healthcare services across multiple regions [1][3][4]. In FY2024, the charity managed <cite id="2">$89,337,007 in total revenue</cite>, which reflects a minor decline from <cite id="2">$94,048,415 in FY2023</cite>. Despite this revenue shift, the organization maintains exceptional third-party ratings, including a <cite id="1">100/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite> and <cite id="11">accreditation by the BBB Wise Giving Alliance</cite> [1][11].

HHRD demonstrates strong financial discipline through efficient resource allocation. The organization filed a <cite id="1">91.2% program expense ratio in FY2024</cite>, while its cash-adjusted program ratio score stands at <cite id="1">87%</cite>, exceeding the <cite id="1">75% industry standard</cite> [1]. Operations are supported by <cite id="1">10.4 months of working capital reserves</cite>, ensuring financial resilience [1]. The organization delivers direct aid globally through key initiatives, including awarding <cite id="8">11,667 higher education scholarships</cite> and conducting specialized medical efforts such as <cite id="10">cataract surgeries and screenings</cite> [8][10]. HHRD holds verified status as a <cite id="17">zakat-eligible charity</cite>, offering a direct giving avenue for Muslim donors [17].
